_: Inkling 2 Small's files for maya-ik2's AMD build (docs/INKLING2_AMD.md): unsloth's UD-Q2_K_XL GGUF set (tools/ik2/pack_gguf.py packs it in place), and the model's DSpark drafter - Thinking Machines' own mtp.safetensors with the config.json that describes it (tools/ik2/convert_dspark.py makes the engine's Q8_0 copy and its index, docs/INKLING2_DSPARK.md). Each file: [bytes, sha256], at the pinned revision. "memory_gb": the VRAM + RAM (GiB) that hold the whole model, the context aside - ceil(these files' 190.9 GiB + the engine's 8 GiB RAM margin + the drafter's 3.2 GiB): its experts outside VRAM are copied into RAM, never read from the SSD (maya.py's IK2_MEMORY_GB says where each part comes from).
